purpose: test the neutral ink-line skeleton proposed to resolve A17.2-A17.4

rule.tolerance: 0.5 * median ink height on the page (derived, not a constant)
rule.ordering: descending baseline = top-to-bottom; ordinal is the index
rule.anchor: first glyph of the cluster, so drift cannot walk a cluster down the page
rule.regions: non-overlapping windows of 8 neutral lines, aligned to page start, short tail kept
rule.projection: nearest neutral baseline within tolerance; no text similarity

synthetic_tests.test: two ordinary adjacent lines
synthetic_tests.implication: ordinary leading separates

synthetic_tests.test: two lines 2pt apart merge (tol=5pt)
synthetic_tests.implication: sub-tolerance baselines are one physical line; this is the documented limit

synthetic_tests.test: superscript rides with its body line
synthetic_tests.implication: footnote markers do not fabricate a line

synthetic_tests.test: subscript rides with its body line
synthetic_tests.implication: same, downward

synthetic_tests.test: large heading then body
synthetic_tests.implication: display type does not swallow body

synthetic_tests.test: letter-spaced display heading is one line
synthetic_tests.implication: the C O N T E N T S case does not become 8 lines

synthetic_tests.test: margin line number joins its body line
synthetic_tests.implication: GPO sets the number on the body baseline

synthetic_tests.test: one physical line from 3 text objects
synthetic_tests.implication: text-object boundaries are invisible to the skeleton

synthetic_tests.test: two-column page MERGES columns (known limit)
synthetic_tests.implication: single-column GPO bills are unaffected; report tables are not, and A17-N records it

synthetic_tests.test: table row of fragments is one line
synthetic_tests.implication: column fragments on a shared baseline are one neutral row

synthetic_tests.test: neutral ids are (page, ordinal) top-to-bottom
synthetic_tests.implication: identity is a pure function of geometry

synthetic_tests.test: identity is stable when glyph ORDER is shuffled
synthetic_tests.implication: input order cannot change identity

synthetic_tests.test: H line projects onto its neutral line
synthetic_tests.implication: geometric projection, no text similarity

synthetic_tests.test: X line at a 1pt offset still projects to the same neutral line
synthetic_tests.implication: sub-tolerance jitter does not move the slot

synthetic_tests.test: a line far from any neutral baseline projects to None
synthetic_tests.implication: fails closed rather than snapping to the nearest

synthetic_tests.test: baseline-proximity projection LOSES a merged line
synthetic_tests.implication: why membership projection replaces it

synthetic_tests.test: membership projection puts a merged line on one slot
synthetic_tests.implication: plurality of glyphs; ties to the lowest ordinal

synthetic_tests.test: membership projection handles a SPLIT line
synthetic_tests.implication: a split half lands on its own neutral line

synthetic_tests.test: membership projection with no glyphs is None
synthetic_tests.implication: fails closed

synthetic_tests.test: centred-narrow flags the centred line only
synthetic_tests.implication: separates a heading from body prose and from a left-aligned paragraph tail

synthetic_tests.test: 20 neutral lines -> 3 non-overlapping regions
synthetic_tests.implication: aligned to page start

synthetic_tests.test: regions partition the lines exactly once
synthetic_tests.implication: no line is dropped or double-counted

synthetic_tests.test: the short trailing region is kept
synthetic_tests.implication: page bottoms carry continuation text and must not be silently dropped
